name: CloudFeed XML Sidebar & Article Widgets
author: Biswabhusan Panda

sections.description:
Helping boost user engagement and reduce bounce rates with informative (live DEMO), easy-to-customize and SEO-friendly free widgets. A well-optimized sidebar improves site usability, visitor retention, and overall website performance. In these custom widgets, all links use nofollow attributes and point to reader-friendly articles. Visitors can read these articles in 200+ global and regional languages.

After installation, the plugin “CloudFeed XML Sidebar & Article Widgets” automatically fits your active WordPress theme. Go to Settings > i20 Sidebar Widgets to customize the record count, border style, and widget height. By default, this plugin spans 100% width. You can display it in your page header, left or right side panel, or inside paragraphs.

Currently, we support 28 popular categories, including:

  • Digitalization
  • Health and Fitness
  • Business Bay
  • Automobiles
  • Free Horoscope
  • SEO Guest Posting
  • Makeup Ideas
  • Travel and Tourism
  • Career Tips
  • Financial Advisor
  • Educational Resources

Each category includes 400+ curated articles. Choose the exact categories that match your website’s niche right from the plugin settings panel.

Technical Details

Dynamic widgets play a key role in modern web design by improving interactivity and personalization. i20 Sidebar Website Widgets for WordPress are completely dynamic and never store or query data inside your WordPress database. Instead, the plugin fetches lightweight data directly from fast SSD/NVMe storage XML feeds. Each feed contains 200+ records across 28 feeds (categories). Using a random PHP selection function, the plugin picks one feed from your chosen categories and displays up to 20 records. This ensures that in 90% of page refreshes, these widgets display fresh, unique records to your visitors.

SEO Features of These Website Widgets

Sidebar widgets are powerful tools that enhance user experience while supporting organic search growth. When implemented thoughtfully, they improve visitor engagement, dwell time, and topical relevance across your site.

This WordPress plugin is built with clean SEO practices in mind. Adding these widgets to your posts, pages, or taxonomy archives displays up to 20 rich article summaries per load. Each row features a detailed 145-word preview, giving visitors helpful context without bloating your local database.

For example, suppose you run a Digital Marketing blog. Inside the i20 Sidebar settings panel, you can select the Digital Marketing feed so relevant posts appear automatically. This keeps readers engaged with related topics and strengthens topical relevance across your pages.

Mobile Compatibility

These sidebar widgets are 100% responsive and adapt smoothly to different screen sizes. This guarantees a seamless reading experience for mobile visitors. The layout automatically adjusts its width and spacing based on the user’s device. On a desktop monitor, the widget displays detailed previews cleanly. On a smartphone screen, it resizes neatly so text and images remain easy to read and tap.

You can display these sidebar widgets anywhere on your site using the shortcode [i20_Sidebar_Widgets].
sections.installation:
1. To install these website widgets for WordPress, go to Plugins in your Admin menu.
  2. Click the Add New button at the top of the page.
  3. Search for i20 Sidebar Widgets and click Install Now, or click Upload Plugin to upload i20-sidebar-widgets.zip.
  4. Click Activate Plugin.
  5. Go to Settings > i20 Sidebar Widgets and copy the shortcode.
  6. Under Appearance > Widgets, add a Text or Shortcode block to your sidebar panel, paste the shortcode, and click Save.
  7. Clear your site cache and refresh your page using CTRL + F5 in your browser.
sections.faq:
How do I disable this WordPress plugin?

Open the standard Plugins page inside your WordPress admin dashboard and click Deactivate. You can also rename the /wp-content/plugins/i20-sidebar-widgets folder via FTP access.

Is this custom sidebar widgets plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes. All outbound article links automatically include rel="nofollow" to protect your site’s link equity, while external XML feeds prevent database bloat.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, it will not slow down your site. The widget scripts only load on specific pages where you add the shortcode, and all data comes from fast external feeds.

Can I select all 28 categories at once?

Yes. Selecting multiple checkboxes tells our engine to include all those category XML feeds. On each page refresh, one category feed is randomly chosen from your selected list.

What happens if I do not select any category?

If you leave all category checkboxes unselected, the widget automatically fetches articles from a curated general feed.

What is the shortcode to display this plugin?

Use the shortcode [i20_Sidebar_Widgets] inside any sidebar widget area, post, or page.

Does this plugin interact with my WordPress database after installation?

No. These widgets never read from or write to your local WordPress database. All content is fetched dynamically from third-party XML feeds hosted on fast NVMe/SSD storage.

Can I use this widget multiple times on a single page?

Yes, you can place the shortcode multiple times on one page, though using a single instance is recommended. All widgets on a page share the same height and record count from the global settings panel.

Which license does this WordPress plugin use?

This plugin is released under the GPLv2 or later license.
